ops.text: desk-runner.py handoff cannot hand off a landing desk. It reads the pid from orca-runner.heartbeat.json, which only the orca desk writes, and writes that pid into <config>.stop. run_landing's loop never calls stop_requested, so a landing runner never exits on a marker. On release-v3 (Oct 22, 0.7.196 and 0.7.198 alike) 'handoff --config runner.json' would have stopped the orca runner (pid 4076) and left the landing runner (pid 43682) running. Fix: a landing heartbeat plus a stop check in run_landing, and a handoff --desk flag.
